procedure: Create actual makeDeliveryDedup and makeTurnCoalescer factories.
Admit A under a source key and mark A pending.
Admit B under that same source key; observe folded=true.
Mirror the live host branch by marking B completed.
Mirror parent busy deferral by claiming/clearing the coalescer and clearing A pending.
coalescing_counterexample.expected: B remains pending with parent or becomes retryable if parent did not submit.
coalescing_counterexample.scope_limit: Does not prove a named live message was lost.
